head.description: One mirrored half of helmet per original. Large amber visor at left x0.02–0.42 y0.38–0.62; blue cheek/chin from x0.02–0.28 y0.49–0.77; side dome/round ear x0.30–0.98 y0.03–0.72; crown band strips x0.01–0.96 y0.77–0.99. Preserve large visor notch silhouette, paint flat central blue guard and lower horizontal vent.
head.shared: Head surface 1 uses hand texture upper strip for dark neck undersuit, not faceplate.

body.description: Original front half-torso chart at left edge x0.01–0.58 y0.22–0.95; collar green surrounds cutout, chest steel blue panels / sage trim, dark fabric abdomen. Right upper diagonal large chart x0.37–0.98 y0.02–0.69 belongs upper thigh with sage side frame and blue thigh plate. Keep empty atlas spaces.

shoulder.description: Upper detached trapezoid x0.14–0.88 y0.02–0.31 is green upward shoulder lip; lower main chart x0.02–0.96 y0.32–0.97 is mirrored round blue shoulder cap and sage lower rim. No extra silhouettes.

hand.description: Large center chart x0.14–0.98 y0.25–0.97: sage upper forearm cuff, blue gauntlet, dark glove underside. Upper strip x0.05–0.93 y0.01–0.24 also shared by helmet neck surface 1: keep this dark woven material with no blue window/gold visor. Small lower-left square dark hand sole.

foot.description: Upper right x0.33–0.90 y0.01–0.45 contains knee and lower shin outer edges; lower chart x0.01–0.99 y0.52–0.99 blue boot/ankle and toe surfaces; green/black fields retain original regions. Match blue boots and dark toe cap.

source_geometry: Original Tank body, hand, foot exactly retained; lower helmet guard locally tightened 2.9786% of smallest original head dimension. All UV coordinates retained.
